text:
No thermal detections were found on this asset for 4 October to 3 November 2026. NASA FIRMS returned zero detections intersecting the property boundary. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the absence of detections isn't a gap in coverage.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, since it doesn't assess burn scars. It doesn't tell us the cause of any change on the property, such as harvest, storm, clearing or fire. And it covers only that one-month window, so it says nothing about earlier or later dates. The data reflects what was known as of 12 November 2026.

In short: no satellite-detected fire activity in the last month, but this is not confirmation that the asset is unaffected. For firmer confirmation, burned-area imagery would be the next check.
